intro: F.M. Berkheimer has kept Central Pennsylvania homes and businesses comfortable since 1950, when founder Foster Berkheimer started the company on two simple principles: hard work and honesty. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the shop serves Mechanicsburg, Camp Hill, Carlisle, Harrisburg, Hershey, and more than twenty surrounding communities. NATE-certified technicians run real load calculations before recommending anything, and the company holds Mitsubishi Electric Diamond Contractor and Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer status. The approach hasn't changed since 1950: no overselling, no cut corners, no disappearing once the job is finished.

services.title: Routine Maintenance
services.blurb: Regular HVAC upkeep to improve efficiency, extend equipment life, and reduce utility bills. Scheduled visits catch small problems before they turn into repairs.

services.title: New Installation
services.blurb: Free in-home estimates with real load calculations for homeowners installing a new furnace, AC, or full HVAC system. Recommendations are sized to the home, not upsold.

services.title: Repair Services
services.blurb: Technicians trained on current equipment diagnose the actual problem first. Straightforward recommendations come before any work begins, on any brand.

services.title: Upgrades & Replacements
services.blurb: Honest guidance on whether to repair or replace an aging system. The call is based on long-term comfort and efficiency, not the easiest sale.

services.title: Indoor Air Quality
services.blurb: Free consultations on filtration, humidity control, and ventilation for today's more tightly sealed homes. AprilAire products install alongside existing systems.

services.title: Water Heaters
services.blurb: Installation, maintenance, and repair for gas, electric, and tankless water heaters. One call covers the whole mechanical side of the home.

process.title: Call or request an estimate
process.blurb: Reach the shop at 717-766-6152 during business hours, or after hours for an emergency. New installations get a free in-home estimate scheduled first.

process.title: A technician diagnoses the real problem
process.blurb: For repairs, a NATE-certified technician inspects the system and finds the actual issue before recommending anything. No guessing, no upsell.

process.title: You get a straightforward recommendation
process.blurb: The technician explains what needs fixing, what it costs, and what the options are, including repair-versus-replace when the system is aging.

process.title: The work gets done right
process.blurb: Installations, repairs, and maintenance visits are completed to code, with 24/7 emergency service available if something goes wrong after.

about: F.M. Berkheimer is a third-generation, family-owned heating and cooling company founded by Foster Berkheimer in 1950 on two principles: hard work and honesty. The shop still serves Mechanicsburg, Camp Hill, New Cumberland, Carlisle, Enola, Harrisburg, Hershey, and more than twenty surrounding Central Pennsylvania communities. The company is bonded, licensed, and insured (PA006087), staffed by NATE-certified technicians, and holds Mitsubishi Electric Diamond Contractor and Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer status alongside partnerships with Generac and AprilAire. It is accredited by the Better Business Bureau and works with NEIF on financing for new installations. Every call starts with a real diagnosis, not a guess, and the company holds to its founding principles: honest, reliable, professional service, with no overselling and no cut corners.

faq.q: What areas does F.M. Berkheimer serve?
faq.a: Mechanicsburg and surrounding Central Pennsylvania communities, including Camp Hill, New Cumberland, Carlisle, Enola, Etters, Boiling Springs, Dillsburg, Dover, Marysville, Wormleysburg, Harrisburg, Hershey, Shermans Dale, Middletown, Lemoyne, Lewisberry, Lower Allen, Shiremanstown, West Fairview, and York Springs, PA.

faq.q: Does F.M. Berkheimer offer emergency service?
faq.a: Yes. Regular hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:30 PM, with 24/7 emergency service available.

faq.q: Is F.M. Berkheimer licensed and insured?
faq.a: Yes. The company is bonded, licensed, and insured (PA license #PA006087), with NATE-certified technicians on staff.

faq.q: Does F.M. Berkheimer offer free estimates?
faq.a: Yes. New installations come with a free in-home estimate and load calculation, and indoor air quality consultations are also free.
